<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>KiNRG, INC.</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>UNAUDITED PRO FORMA CONDENSED COMBINED FINANCIAL
INFORMATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Introduction</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">The following unaudited pro forma condensed combined financial information
is presented to illustrate the estimated effects of the acquisition by KiNRG, Inc. (&quot;KiNRG&quot; or the &quot;Company&quot;) of 100%
of the issued and outstanding equity interests of Trinity Group Construction, Inc. (&quot;Trinity), completed on April 1, 2026 (the &quot;Acquisition&quot;),
pursuant to the Stock Purchase Agreement dated March 31, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">The Acquisition was completed in exchange for (i) $1,000,000 in cash,
(ii) 4,200,000 shares of KiNRG common stock, and (iii) a promissory note in the principal amount of $3,000,000 (the &ldquo;Promissory
Note&rdquo;).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">The unaudited pro forma condensed combined balance sheet as of December
31, 2025 gives effect to the Acquisition as if it had been consummated on December 31, 2025. The unaudited pro forma condensed combined
statement of operations for the year ended December 31, 2025 gives effect to the Acquisition as if it had been consummated on January
1, 2025.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">The pro forma financial information was prepared using the acquisition
method under ASC 805, Business Combinations, with KiNRG as the acquirer. The information is preliminary and subject to revision as valuations
are finalized during the measurement period (up to one year). It should be read in conjunction with: (i) the audited financial statements
of Trinity (Exhibit 99.1); (ii) the audited consolidated financial statements of KiNRG; and (iii) the notes herein.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Preliminary Purchase Price</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">The purchase consideration is as follows, based on sales of KiNRG stock
at $1.00 per share on September 26, 2025:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">
  <TR STYLE="vertical-align: bottom; background-color: rgb(204,238,255)">
    <TD STYLE="width: 88%">Cash</TD><TD STYLE="width: 1%">&nbsp;</TD>
    <TD STYLE="width: 1%; text-align: left">$</TD><TD STYLE="width: 9%; text-align: right">1,000,000</TD><TD STYLE="width: 1%; text-align: left">&nbsp;</TD></TR>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Goodwill represents the expected synergies from growth opportunities
not separately identifiable. None of the goodwill is expected to be deductible for income tax purposes, as the transaction is intended
to qualify as a tax-free reorganization under IRC Section 368(a)(1)(B).</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt; text-align: center"><B>KiNRG, INC. </B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center"><B>NOTES TO UNAUDITED PRO FORMA CONDENSED COMBINED
FINANCIAL INFORMATION</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: center">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Note 1. Description of the Acquisition</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: justify; margin: 0pt 0">On November 7, 2025, KiNRG (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) and Mil L. Wallen,
owner of 100% of the shares of Trinity Group Construction, a Virginia Corporation (the &ldquo;Sellers&rdquo;) entered into a Letter of
Intent for the acquisition of Trinity by the Company, subject to definitive agreement (the &ldquo;LOI&rdquo;). On March 31, 2026, the
Company entered into a Stock Purchase Agreement (the &ldquo;Purchase Agreement&rdquo;) with Trinity and Millard L. Wallen, III (the &ldquo;Seller&rdquo;),
pursuant to which the Company agreed to acquire 100% of the issued and outstanding capital stock of Trinity (the &ldquo;Acquisition&rdquo;).
The closing of the Acquisition occurred on April 1, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Note 2. Purchase Price </B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">The purchase price consists of the following:<B>&nbsp; </B>(i) $1,000,000
cash; (ii) 4,200,000 shares of KiNRG common stock, par value $0.0001 per share, at a price of $2.00 per share, the price of arms-length
sales of the Company&rsquo;s common stock in March, 2026; (iii) a note payable in the amount of $3,000,000 an interest rate of 6% per
annum due on the earlier of the closing of a public offering by the Company or September 30, 2026.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Note 3. Basis of Presentation</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Historical KiNRG data is from the audited Form 10-K for FY2025 ($0
revenue, $350,937 total assets, $2,704,605 net loss). Historical Trinity data is from the audited financial statements for FY2025 ($257.3M
revenue, $69.4M total assets, $3.8M net income). Transaction Accounting Adjustments reflect application of ASC 805 as described in Note
4. No Management's Adjustments or Autonomous Entity Adjustments have been included.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Note 4. Pro Forma Adjustments</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">N<B>ote 5. Pro Forma Earnings Per Share</B></P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Pro forma basic and diluted EPS are calculated as follows:</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Pro forma net income: $1,070,855.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Pro forma weighted average basic shares: 54,832,811 (KiNRG historical)
+ 4,200,000 (closing shares as if outstanding since January 1, 2025) = 59,032,811.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Pro forma basic EPS Continuing Operations &ndash; basic and diluted:
$1,070,855 / 59,032,811 = $0.018 per share.</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: justify; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>
